docker/weg2-release/entrypoint.sh.rule: NOT exempt. collision_survey.py reports the file as an open name-rule collision and the mechanical pass (F0-D) aborts on it until entrypoint.sh no longer spells both names as plain tokens: F0-B rewrites it for both names and builds the OLD names from pieces (like the name_compat tests: "SG" "LANG_"), or the pass content-locks it.
